svg.title: Gabriel’s horn: a 1/x surface with finite volume and infinite area
svg.desc: A blue wireframe horn narrows as x increases. A companion cutoff chart shows the volume approaching pi while the surface area keeps growing like 2 pi log R.
svg.text: The surface of revolution r = 1/x, shown only over a finite viewing window
What changes as the cutoff R moves right?
A finite picture cannot display the whole infinite horn.
It shows the rule, not a physical object at infinity.
The comparison is mathematical, not physical.
